# moment 5a: ctrl+c while the lead is idle and sub-agents work asks to confirm, and a second press within 3 s stops both.
type subagents-5a-ctrl-c-twice-while-idle-stops-both
key enter
wait 2 sub-agents running
key ctrl+c
wait this will stop 2 sub-agents, press Ctrl+C again to confirm
absent ○
clock 2s
key ctrl+c
wait ○
absent 2 sub-agents running
absent quit
